generation.scope: Every finite rank-nine window with a simple local component and four-dimensional middle supports has at least one symmetric opposite pair. An irreducible four-plane in sl3 has at least three independent commutators. A rank-at-most-two generator of the remaining symmetric quadratic kernel certifies regularity. The open cases in this stratum reduce to rank-three or rank-four symmetric kernels.

open_mathematics: Analyze the two binary factors of a rank-four symmetric kernel and the degenerate rank-three case. Also treat finite graphs with no simple component, higher opposite ranks, positive-dimensional fibers and global specializations.
